BINARY, DECIMAL AND HEXADECIMAL
========================================

ASCII characters as 8-bit binary:
  'A' = dec  65 = bin 01000001 = hex 0x41
  'B' = dec  66 = bin 01000010 = hex 0x42
  'C' = dec  67 = bin 01000011 = hex 0x43
  'D' = dec  68 = bin 01000100 = hex 0x44
  'E' = dec  69 = bin 01000101 = hex 0x45
  'F' = dec  70 = bin 01000110 = hex 0x46
  'G' = dec  71 = bin 01000111 = hex 0x47
  'H' = dec  72 = bin 01001000 = hex 0x48
  'I' = dec  73 = bin 01001001 = hex 0x49
  'a' = dec  97 = bin 01100001 = hex 0x61
  'b' = dec  98 = bin 01100010 = hex 0x62
  'c' = dec  99 = bin 01100011 = hex 0x63
  'd' = dec 100 = bin 01100100 = hex 0x64
  'e' = dec 101 = bin 01100101 = hex 0x65
  'f' = dec 102 = bin 01100110 = hex 0x66
  'g' = dec 103 = bin 01100111 = hex 0x67
  'h' = dec 104 = bin 01101000 = hex 0x68
  'i' = dec 105 = bin 01101001 = hex 0x69
  '0' = dec  48 = bin 00110000 = hex 0x30
  '1' = dec  49 = bin 00110001 = hex 0x31
  '2' = dec  50 = bin 00110010 = hex 0x32
  '3' = dec  51 = bin 00110011 = hex 0x33
  '4' = dec  52 = bin 00110100 = hex 0x34
  '5' = dec  53 = bin 00110101 = hex 0x35
  '6' = dec  54 = bin 00110110 = hex 0x36
  '7' = dec  55 = bin 00110111 = hex 0x37
  '8' = dec  56 = bin 00111000 = hex 0x38
  '9' = dec  57 = bin 00111001 = hex 0x39
  ' ' = dec  32 = bin 00100000 = hex 0x20
  '.' = dec  46 = bin 00101110 = hex 0x2E
  '!' = dec  33 = bin 00100001 = hex 0x21
  '?' = dec  63 = bin 00111111 = hex 0x3F

Text encoded to binary:
  'BrainAI' -> 01000010 01110010 01100001 01101001 01101110 01000001 01001001
  'Zahid' -> 01011010 01100001 01101000 01101001 01100100
  'spike' -> 01110011 01110000 01101001 01101011 01100101
  '01010101' -> 00110000 00110001 00110000 00110001 00110000 00110001 00110000 00110001

Number base conversions:
  dec 197 = bin 11000101 = hex 0xC5 = oct 0o305
  dec 215 = bin 11010111 = hex 0xD7 = oct 0o327
  dec  20 = bin 00010100 = hex 0x14 = oct 0o024
  dec 132 = bin 10000100 = hex 0x84 = oct 0o204
  dec 248 = bin 11111000 = hex 0xF8 = oct 0o370
  dec 207 = bin 11001111 = hex 0xCF = oct 0o317
  dec 155 = bin 10011011 = hex 0x9B = oct 0o233
  dec 244 = bin 11110100 = hex 0xF4 = oct 0o364
  dec 183 = bin 10110111 = hex 0xB7 = oct 0o267
  dec 111 = bin 01101111 = hex 0x6F = oct 0o157
  dec  71 = bin 01000111 = hex 0x47 = oct 0o107
  dec 144 = bin 10010000 = hex 0x90 = oct 0o220
  dec  71 = bin 01000111 = hex 0x47 = oct 0o107
  dec  48 = bin 00110000 = hex 0x30 = oct 0o060
  dec 128 = bin 10000000 = hex 0x80 = oct 0o200
  dec  75 = bin 01001011 = hex 0x4B = oct 0o113
  dec 158 = bin 10011110 = hex 0x9E = oct 0o236
  dec  50 = bin 00110010 = hex 0x32 = oct 0o062
  dec  37 = bin 00100101 = hex 0x25 = oct 0o045
  dec 169 = bin 10101001 = hex 0xA9 = oct 0o251
  dec 241 = bin 11110001 = hex 0xF1 = oct 0o361
  dec  51 = bin 00110011 = hex 0x33 = oct 0o063
  dec 181 = bin 10110101 = hex 0xB5 = oct 0o265
  dec 222 = bin 11011110 = hex 0xDE = oct 0o336
  dec 161 = bin 10100001 = hex 0xA1 = oct 0o241
  dec 104 = bin 01101000 = hex 0x68 = oct 0o150
  dec 244 = bin 11110100 = hex 0xF4 = oct 0o364
  dec 226 = bin 11100010 = hex 0xE2 = oct 0o342
  dec 133 = bin 10000101 = hex 0x85 = oct 0o205
  dec  31 = bin 00011111 = hex 0x1F = oct 0o037
  dec   7 = bin 00000111 = hex 0x07 = oct 0o007
  dec  47 = bin 00101111 = hex 0x2F = oct 0o057
  dec 204 = bin 11001100 = hex 0xCC = oct 0o314
  dec   0 = bin 00000000 = hex 0x00 = oct 0o000
  dec 252 = bin 11111100 = hex 0xFC = oct 0o374
  dec 170 = bin 10101010 = hex 0xAA = oct 0o252
  dec 124 = bin 01111100 = hex 0x7C = oct 0o174
  dec 166 = bin 10100110 = hex 0xA6 = oct 0o246
  dec  32 = bin 00100000 = hex 0x20 = oct 0o040
  dec  97 = bin 01100001 = hex 0x61 = oct 0o141

Binary arithmetic:
  0111000 + 0111101 = 01110101   (56 + 61 = 117)
  00111000 AND 00111101 = 00111000
  00111000 XOR 00111101 = 00000101
  0100100 + 1110010 = 10010110   (36 + 114 = 150)
  00100100 AND 01110010 = 00100000
  00100100 XOR 01110010 = 01010110
  0010111 + 0010100 = 00101011   (23 + 20 = 43)
  00010111 AND 00010100 = 00010100
  00010111 XOR 00010100 = 00000011
  1010001 + 1111101 = 11001110   (81 + 125 = 206)
  01010001 AND 01111101 = 01010001
  01010001 XOR 01111101 = 00101100
  0011011 + 1001101 = 01101000   (27 + 77 = 104)
  00011011 AND 01001101 = 00001001
  00011011 XOR 01001101 = 01010110
  1001010 + 0011111 = 01101001   (74 + 31 = 105)
  01001010 AND 00011111 = 00001010
  01001010 XOR 00011111 = 01010101
  1010101 + 0110100 = 10001001   (85 + 52 = 137)
  01010101 AND 00110100 = 00010100
  01010101 XOR 00110100 = 01100001
  1001001 + 1110001 = 10111010   (73 + 113 = 186)
  01001001 AND 01110001 = 01000001
  01001001 XOR 01110001 = 00111000
  0010111 + 1100010 = 01111001   (23 + 98 = 121)
  00010111 AND 01100010 = 00000010
  00010111 XOR 01100010 = 01110101
  1010001 + 0111101 = 10001110   (81 + 61 = 142)
  01010001 AND 00111101 = 00010001
  01010001 XOR 00111101 = 01101100
  1001010 + 0101111 = 01111001   (74 + 47 = 121)
  01001010 AND 00101111 = 00001010
  01001010 XOR 00101111 = 01100101
  0110000 + 0101111 = 01011111   (48 + 47 = 95)
  00110000 AND 00101111 = 00100000
  00110000 XOR 00101111 = 00011111
  0001000 + 1000010 = 01001010   (8 + 66 = 74)
  00001000 AND 01000010 = 00000000
  00001000 XOR 01000010 = 01001010
  1111001 + 0010001 = 10001010   (121 + 17 = 138)
  01111001 AND 00010001 = 00010001
  01111001 XOR 00010001 = 01101000
  0010110 + 0100001 = 00110111   (22 + 33 = 55)
  00010110 AND 00100001 = 00000000
  00010110 XOR 00100001 = 00110111
  0100110 + 0001001 = 00101111   (38 + 9 = 47)
  00100110 AND 00001001 = 00000000
  00100110 XOR 00001001 = 00101111
  0010100 + 1100100 = 01111000   (20 + 100 = 120)
  00010100 AND 01100100 = 00000100
  00010100 XOR 01100100 = 01110000
  1000110 + 0111100 = 10000010   (70 + 60 = 130)
  01000110 AND 00111100 = 00000100
  01000110 XOR 00111100 = 01111010
  0110111 + 1101011 = 10100010   (55 + 107 = 162)
  00110111 AND 01101011 = 00100011
  00110111 XOR 01101011 = 01011100
  1000110 + 1110011 = 10111001   (70 + 115 = 185)
  01000110 AND 01110011 = 01000010
  01000110 XOR 01110011 = 00110101
